ColumnIssueDetailSchema.title: ColumnIssueDetailSchema
ColumnIssueDetailSchema.description: Optional rich detail for a column-level issue (sample rows / counts).

IntegrationEnvironment.title: IntegrationEnvironment
IntegrationEnvironment.description: Target deployment environment for credentials and connection requests.

IntegrationStatus.title: IntegrationStatus
IntegrationStatus.description:
Integration state shown in the portal.

``NOT_CONFIGURED`` is virtual: it is never persisted and means
"no active integration request for the project". Only
``SETUP_IN_PROGRESS`` and ``CONNECTED`` are stored in the DB.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Expiry instant with timezone (RFC 3339); stored as timestamptz.

NotAllowedValueDetailSchema.title: NotAllowedValueDetailSchema
NotAllowedValueDetailSchema.description: One disallowed value with optional ML diagnostics.

product_run_id.title: Product Run Id
product_run_id.description: Internal primary key of the product run in Client Portal API.

product_run_external_id.title: Product Run External Id
product_run_external_id.description: ML platform batch id for one product inference run (SQS field ``product_run_id``). Groups ML service runs of the same product batch; not the internal ``product_run_id`` UUID. Null while a schedule pre-created run is awaiting its first ML platform event.

scheduled_at.title: Scheduled At
scheduled_at.description: Inference schedule fire time the run was pre-created for; null for event-created runs.

aggregated_ml_service_run_status_id.title: Aggregated Ml Service Run Status Id

ProjectApiCredentialLogItemSchema.title: ProjectApiCredentialLogItemSchema
ProjectApiCredentialLogItemSchema.description: Authentik event payload (extra fields allowed for now).

missing_required_columns.title: Missing Required Columns
missing_required_columns.description: ML or portal: required CSV columns absent from upload.

missing_values.title: Missing Values
missing_values.description: ML: columns with null values in required fields (flat column names).

missing_values_details.title: Missing Values Details
missing_values_details.description: ML: per-column error_count and sample_rows for missing_values.

wrong_column_type.title: Wrong Column Type
wrong_column_type.description: ML: expected vs actual dtype per column.

not_allowed_values.title: Not Allowed Values
not_allowed_values.description: ML: disallowed enum/value per column (flat value lists).

not_allowed_values_details.title: Not Allowed Values Details
not_allowed_values_details.description: ML: per-value error_count and sample_rows for not_allowed_values.

expected_values.title: Expected Values
expected_values.description: ML: expected whitelist per column (for not_allowed_values report).

extra_columns.title: Extra Columns
extra_columns.description: Portal prevalidation: CSV columns not in the dataset template.

header_errors.title: Header Errors
header_errors.description: Portal prevalidation: malformed CSV header row.

ValidationErrorsSchema.title: ValidationErrorsSchema
ValidationErrorsSchema.description:
Canonical validation payload stored in DB and returned in HTTP responses.

Wire-format conversion (ML flat SQS, ML rich collector) happens in
``normalize_validation_errors_payload`` before field validation.
See ``wire.py`` for the format matrix.

WrongColumnTypeDetailSchema.title: WrongColumnTypeDetailSchema
WrongColumnTypeDetailSchema.description: Type mismatch for one column (ML platform shape).
